operations.action: Load the amos-distinction-relation-constraint-rscf-algebra skill and its content

integrity_requirements: Law of Law: no unresolved contradictions within the skill's scope
Epistemic class: all claims labeled SOURCE / DERIVED / AMOS_MODEL / EMPIRICAL
Provenance: source path recorded for every derived claim
Anti-overreach: no claim beyond the skill's declared scope
Failure mode: on validation failure, downgrade confidence, flag the gap, escalate
safety_constraints: No claim beyond established evidence or explicitly labeled AMOS_MODEL
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders
